text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose anymore. I need a win, and I
need it
now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hurry up and enter me in
another race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For every time I lose, I need to win at
least twice
as much! I have to prove I'm
not weak!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to take a break! I can't
go on
being a loser like this!
choice_data_list: 今は体を休めて、次に備えよう
焦っても結果は覆せない！
choice_data_list_en: Let's rest your body for now and prepare for what's next.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: 君は強い。それは変わらない
貴方は強い。それは変わらない

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I am strong. No matter how
many
times I lose, that won't change.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I lost sight of what's important. I'll
make
sure to give my body a proper
break.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll totally clean up in the next
race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know that, but... I don't like feeling like
this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Feeling so weak. It feels terrible. I can't
stand
another second of this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: なら今やるべきことはひとつ
choice_data_list_en: Then there's only one thing we should do right now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: もっと強くなろう、テイオー！

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I will. I'll become so strong that no one
will be
able to pass me ever again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll reclaim that victory, those cheers,
and my
pride with these two legs!
